observations: Three photos show a hairdryer and hairstreamer set on a tiled floor.
The device has a large, rounded, blue and grey plastic head with a visible blue interior.
It includes a stand with two adjustable arms, each with a black nozzle or attachment.
A power cord is visible, extending from the base to a plug.
The stand appears to be made of grey plastic with a camouflage-like pattern on one arm.
No brand or model name is visible on any part of the device in any photo.
The device is not plugged in or turned on in any photo.
The photos are watermarked with 'AYOMAYOWA OLANIKEKUN' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.

claims.evidence: The photos show a hairdryer and hairstreamer set, matching the description.

claims.claim: Like new, never repaired or opened, works perfectly. Original receipt and warranty available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The device may not work or may have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the device turned on, with the heater and steam function operating.

risks.risk: The stand or attachments may be damaged or missing parts.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the stand and all attachments, showing no cracks, loose parts, or missing nozzles.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly incomplete or damaged

risks.risk: The power cord or plug may be damaged or incompatible with Nigerian outlets.
risks.proof: Close-up of the plug and cord, showing no fraying or damage, and a photo of the plug type (e.g., Type F or G).

proof_requests: Video of the device turned on, showing the heater and steam function working.
Close-up photos of the stand and all attachments, showing no damage or missing parts.
Close-up of the power cord and plug, showing no damage and identifying the plug type.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
